title: [LOGGED OUT] Store footer shows the social icons, links and the language button

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store and wait until loaded.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown at the bottom; clicked Dismiss.
Scrolled to the bottom of the page; footer visible.

steps.text: Are 6 social icon links shown (YouTube, X, TikTok, Discord, Instagram, Facebook)?
steps.saw: 6 icon links in order: YouTube (youtube.com/@playludus), X (twitter.com/playludus), TikTok, Discord, Instagram, Facebook.

steps.text: Are "Support", "Powered by Xsolla Web Shop", "Join Affiliate Program", "Privacy settings" and the "EN" button shown?
steps.saw: All shown: Support, Powered by Xsolla Web Shop, Join Affiliate Program, Privacy settings; EN language button at right.

steps.text: Is a copyright line that starts with "©" and ends with "LUDUS" shown?
